tei:div.tei:p: 137) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: ḍā ki'i thugs kyi sgrub pa dngos grub bum bzang bzhugs: 138) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: dus gsum rgyal dang rgyal sras yongs 'dus dpal: che ba'i che mchog rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dngos grub kun bdag bde chen mchog gi sku: mthong ba don ldan gu ru pad+mar 'dud: gang gi thugs kyi gsang 'dzin kho mo ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan don chen du: rang gi sgrub pa dngos grub bum bzang bstan: tshul bzhin nyams su len kun grol bar nges: sa ma ya: snang cha thabs kyi dkyil 'khor du: stong nyid shes rab yongs grub ltar: shes shing rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: bsgom bzlas mchog tu 'di zab bo: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: sku gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i skur: 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: phyogs ris bral ba'i sems can kun: yang dag sar 'god sems bskyed do: lan gsum brjod: mthar dngos gzhi ni: āḥ bsam brjod bral ba gdod ma'i gzhi: kun snang 'gro la khyab par brdal: rig pa rgyu yi yi ge bam̐: de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus byas: don gnyis bsgrubs shing dwangs bcud bsdus: yongs gyur dbyings phyug yum lnga'i klong: ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i: zhing dang gzhal yas lhun grub dbus: skyon bral pad nyi rgyas 139)pa'i steng: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rig pa chos nyid don gyi lha: bde chen ye shes mtsho rgyal la: sor rtogs rang mdangs sku mdog dmar: nyag gcig zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mdzes: sku gsum ye shes spyan gsum ldan: longs sku 'gags med ljags pad srab: mtshan bzang tshems phreng rab tu mdzes: bden gnyis shangs dang don gnyis snyan: thabs shes phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis: bde chen mchog ster cag te'u 'khrol: g.yon pa stong nyid dril bu 'dzin: mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i phyir: dbu skra thor cog zar bu grol:

ye shes lnga rdzogs rtse bran dang: snang ba rang grol dar snas brgyan: tshogs drug gnas dag rus rgyan dang: sems byung dag pa'i ut+pa la: dmar po'i phreng bas do shal mdzes: srid zhi dag mnyam zhabs gnyis kyis: zung 'jug mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol phyir: chu skyes 'o 'dzin rab tu rgyas: dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i: gnas lngar thod phreng rigs lnga dang: rtsa khams sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor 140)rdzogs: rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: a tsar+ya gzhon cang dril 'khrol: rang snang bde chen yum dang sbyor: ye shes bzhi yi phyag rgya mo: rang rtags phyag mtshan rgyan chas rdzogs: snang stong gnyis med ye shes lha: chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin du gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba rnams: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rnam pa ru: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su sol: gdan gsum 'khor lo'i dal du bzhugs: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ye phyag 'tshal: kun snang bkod pa'i rgyan gyis mchod: chos nyid brdal ba chen por bstod: sa ma ya shad+dhe āḥ hūm̐: stong gsal ma 'gags mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ru: ye shes sems ma phag mo mthing gsal mdzes: de yi thugs klong thabs shes gwa'u'i dbus: bam̐ dmar mtha' mar sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor: de las 'od 'phros rigs bdag thugs rgyud bskul: rgyal kun gsang gsum yon tan dbang byin kun: 'od dmar rnam par bsdus te rang la bstim: sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du dag mnyam rol: oṃ pad+ma dzñā na ḍā ki ni sa ra dza ya sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: ces rtsa sngags bzlas pa bye ba dang: sgrub pa la sogs dmigs pas dbye: lus dkyil snying po spyi dril ni: 141) 142) oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā pradzñā dzñā na sid+dhi hūm̐: 'bum bzlas dngos grub thob par nges: bsgom tshe lhar snang 'bral mi bya: bzlas tshe smra bcad 'khyal tshig spongs:

gab pa bzhi ldan gnad gcun pas: gsal dag brtan pa rab thob nas: zung 'jug phyag rgya'i sku thob nges: sa ma ya: de ltar ḍā ki'i thugs sgrub zab mo 'di: rdo rje zhi ba mtsho la gces nor gdams: da dung ma spel rin chen gter rgyas thob: ma 'ongs snyigs ma snyigs dus ngoms pa'i tshe: nga sprul nga dang gnyis med thugs kyi ming: gtsug phud lcang lo dung gi zur phud can: a te'i bstan pas yul gsum khyab par 'dzin: tha mal tshul 'chang ma nges yul kun rgyu: bai ro nam snying g.yu sgra zung ldan sprul: gsang grogs (Dakini secret letter here) dang 'phrad gyur na: mkha' 'gro'i thugs sgrub rnam gsum gter gyi bcud: 'dir 'phrad 'gro don dpag med 'byung bar nges: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung tshe ring mched lngas gnyer gyis shig: las can pad+ma dh+wa dza'i dpal du sprod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang dad ldan skyes bu shākya'i dge btsun don ming 'dzin pas kha dog bkra ba'i mdangs 'dzin reg bya'i skyes bcas nan cher bskul ngor snyoms las pa su kha dzñā na'i ming gis nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// ༈ skabs su mchod pa'i las rim ni: oṃ: ka dag 143)dbyings las shar ba yi: bde chen zag med mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ma hā su kha badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da rū pa sogs: spar+she ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta bha liṃ ta rak+ta la khā hiḥ zhes mchod cing bstod pa ni: hūm̐: sku ni mi 'gyur bde chen kun bzang mo: gsung ni mi 'gags mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung: thugs ni mi g.yo khyab brdal spros dang bral: sku gsung thugs ldan ḍā ki'i rje mor bstod: tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes bzung nas: zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog:

ces pa'ang su kha dzñā nas nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o/ ༈ gab pa bzhi ldan ni/ bdag snang dam tshig sems dpar gab// dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpar gab// ye shes sems dpa' ting 'dzin sems dpar gab// ting 'dzin sems dpa' chos nyid kyi klong du gab pa'o// de ltar gongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gnad gcun la// gsal ba ting nge 'dzin gyi gzer/ dag pa lha'i rnam dag dran pa/ brtan pa yid kyi yul du gsal bar brtan pa/ dbang po'i yul du snang zhing mi 'gyur ba/ mngon gyur rig pa'i yul du brtan pa thob pa'o/ mchan/ ha ha/ ka dag gi 144)rig pa thad grol du bskyangs tshe/ kha dog la mi ltos chos nyid kyi bzhugs tshul// ga le ru mjal tshe rtsal snang gi brda ris// nga bdag gis bcas bcos dag ther ni ma byas// shes rab kyi mig ldan mkhyen yangs tshos gzigs dang*// tshig ro dang mthun pa'i yig skyon re yod thang*// lus dman gyi bu mo shes rab de chung bas// rjod tshig gi spros pa'i mtha' dpyod ni mi shes// yig mkhan gyi bka' babs pad 'byung gi pho nya// tshul rdor dang don ming 'dzin pa yis dpyad mdzod/ ces su kha badz+ra nas so//
